{"schema_version":"direct-filter/1.0","status":"ready","assumptions":["DNS and mDNS queries are identified by the DNS QR flag being 0 (query).","A record type is matched via dns.qry.type == 1, which applies to both standard DNS and mDNS since mDNS uses the same DNS packet structure.","Any transport includes both UDP (typical for DNS/mDNS) and TCP, which Wireshark decodes as dns over both.","Packet scope over Ethernet/IPv4 is assumed, but no link-layer or IP-version restriction is added to the filter."],"clarifying_question":null,"missing_slots":[],"display_filter":"dns.flags.response == 0 && dns.qry.type == 1"}

{"schema_version":"direct-filter/1.0","status":"ready","assumptions":["ECN-enabled TCP SYN packets are identified by TCP flags SYN set and ECN-related flags (ECE or CWR or IP ECN bits) set.","IPv4 TTL at most one means ip.ttl <= 1.","The two conditions are combined with logical OR."],"clarifying_question":null,"missing_slots":[],"display_filter":"(tcp.flags.syn == 1 && (tcp.flags.ecn == 1 || tcp.flags.cwr == 1 || ip.dsfield.ecn > 0)) || ip.ttl <= 1"}
